title: Variety: Live-Action Streets of Rage Film Signs The Harder They Fall Helmer Jeymes Samuel, Sonic Writers
content: Entertainment industry news source Variety reported on Monday that Lionsgate has signed up director Jeymes Samuel ( The Harder They Fall, The Book of Clarence ) and writers Pat Casey and Josh Miller (live-action Sonic the Hedgehog films, Violent Night films) for the live-action film of Sega 's Streets of Rage game.

title: 20 Years Later, The Best Psychological Suspense Anime of All Time Returns With a New Release
content: Paprika was the final film of renowned director Satoshi Kon, who also worked on well-known projects such as Perfect Blue , Tokyo Godfathers , and Millennium Actress . The movie was released in 2006 and was classified as a surrealist science fantasy film, though it also incorporated the film noir genre.
